video.title: AI欧腐《被继兄上线牵住了/Logged in and Leashed by My Stepbrother》
video.desc:
By day, Neilo battles Crevan, his insufferable boss and new stepbrother. By night, he submits to a gentle but commanding online Master. When Crevan discovers Neilo is his beloved puppy, their hidden worlds collide. Can the man Neilo hates become the Master he loves?
白天，Neilo要和自己难以忍受的老板、同时也是新继兄的Crevan针锋相对。
到了夜晚，他却在网上臣服于一位温柔却强势的Master。
当Crevan发现，Neilo竟然就是自己心爱的“小狗”时，两人隐藏的世界彻底碰撞。Neilo白天最讨厌的那个男人，真的会成为他夜里深爱的主人吗？
